digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler field contract & property tests
propositions: Reconciler parity bugs (3f04, 4b59, 32cc) escape because per-field asymmetry policy is scattered across multiple call sites with no single declarative source.
A declarative field-contract registry must enumerate each reconciled field with its symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, one-way-with-propagation-gate) and references to its codec/gate.
Property tests parameterized off the registry must enforce coverage: collection fails if any handled field in inbound_differ/apply_inbound_records lacks a registry entry.
Roundtrip identity, add-wins idempotence, and gate-consulted behavior must be asserted through real call paths, with symmetry class properties validated against the declared registry.
The registry and architecture documentation establish a durable registration contract so new reconciled fields must declare their symmetry class or the build fails.
